title: Hierarchical Sparse Bayesian Multitask Learning for Disease Prediction in Pooled Microbiome Studies
abstract: arXiv:2502.02552v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper proposes a hierarchical Bayesian multitask learning model that is applicable to the general multi-task binary classification learning problem where the model assumes a shared sparsity structure across different tasks. We derive a computationally efficient inference algorithm based on variational inference to approximate the posterior distribution. We demonstrate the potential of the new approach on various synthetic datasets and for predicting human health status based on microbiome profile. Our analysis incorporates data pooled from multiple microbiome studies, along with a comprehensive comparison with other benchmark methods. Results in synthetic datasets show that the proposed approach has superior support recovery property when the underlying regression coefficients share a common sparsity structure across different tasks. translated_title: 用于合并微生物组研究中疾病预测的分层稀疏贝叶斯多任务学习
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种分层贝叶斯多任务学习模型，适用于一般的多任务二分类学习问题，该模型假设不同任务之间共享稀疏结构。我们推导了一种基于变分推断的计算高效推断算法来近似后验分布。我们在各种合成数据集上以及基于微生物组谱预测人类健康状况方面展示了新方法的潜力。我们的分析纳入了来自多项微生物组研究的合并数据，并与其他基准方法进行了全面比较。合成数据集的结果表明，当底层回归系数在不同任务间共享共同的稀疏结构时，所提出的方法具有优越的支持恢复特性。我们在微生物组分类上的实验证明了该方法在提取相关特征方面的实用性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种假设任务间共享稀疏结构的分层稀疏贝叶斯多任务学习模型，通过变分推断实现高效计算，在合成数据和基于微生物组谱的疾病预测中展现出优越的支持恢复性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hierarchical sparse Bayesian multitask learning model assuming shared sparsity structure across tasks, achieving efficient computation via variational inference and demonstrating superior support recovery performance on synthetic data and microbiome-based disease prediction.
